Как посмотреть, что сказали несколько ми: How do I see what was said a few minutes ago?
В настройках, раздел «Распознавание речи: In Settings, Speech recognition, turn on "Transcript during the meeting". It works with recognition on this computer.
Во время записи речь распознается пример: While recording, speech is recognized about every half a minute: under the notes in the notepad, the "Now" section shows the latest phrases with the recording minute.
Щелчок по фразе вставляет ее в заметки с: A click on a phrase puts it into the notes with its minute.
В поле «Спросить» задайте вопрос о сказа: In the "Ask" field ask about what was said, for example "what did the client promise to send?", and click **Ask**: the minutes model answers with the minutes where it was said.
Распознавание во время встречи нагружает: Recognition during the meeting loads the processor; the final transcript after the meeting is made as usual. A question is paid as a request to the minutes model. Participants don't see the section while "Hide the bar when sharing the screen" is on.
Нажмите **Подготовить вопросы**: модель: Click **Prepare questions**: the minutes model suggests questions for the client by the meeting kind and a "Before the meeting" checklist of what to request in advance. They are added at the end of the prep, your text stays as is.
Уходят ли в облако телефоны, ИНН и други: Do phone numbers, tax numbers and other personal data go to the cloud?
Нет, пока включено «Скрывать личные данн: No, while "Hide personal data from the cloud model" is on (Settings, Minutes, on by default).
Перед отправкой облачной модели телефоны: Before the text goes to a cloud model, phone numbers, e-mails, tax and social security numbers, passports, card and account numbers and addresses become labels like [ТЕЛЕФОН_1]. The minutes on your computer get the real values back.
Так же скрываются данные в подготовке во: The same goes for the meeting prep, questions during the meeting and the task for your AI assistant over MCP.
«Скрывать и имена людей» заменяет меткам: "Hide people's names too" turns the participants' names into labels as well. The model then writes full names and task assignees worse.
Модель на этом компьютере или в вашей се: A model on this computer or in your network (Ollama, LM Studio, your own server) gets the text as is. Audio sent to cloud speech recognition can't be hidden: to keep it on the computer, recognize on this computer. Numbers said in words are not found.
Как сохранить протокол или расшифровку ф: How do I save the minutes or the transcript as a file?
Протокол: нажмите **Скопировать** и выбе: Minutes: click **Copy** and choose **Save as file (PDF, Word)…**.
Расшифровка: на вкладке «Расшифровка» на: Transcript: on the Transcript tab click **…** and choose **Save as file (PDF, Word)…**.
В окне сохранения выберите тип файла: PD: In the save dialog choose the file type: PDF or Word document.
В протокол идет тот же текст, что в пись: The minutes file has the same text as the email: no timestamps and no analyst-only section. The transcript file has the title, date, participants and the phrases with their time; marks and your notes are not included.
Что будет, если выйти во время записи ил: What happens if I exit during a recording or a transcription?
The app asks whether to exit.
Запись сохранится: программа закроется,: The recording is saved: the app closes as soon as it is assembled.
Распознавание и протокол прервутся, их м: Transcription and minutes stop; you can start them again from the meeting list.
Заметки не сохранились. Что делать?: The notes were not saved. What do I do?
Под текстом блокнота видна причина, напр: The reason is under the notepad text, for example the disk is full or the file is busy.
Текст остается в блокноте, а копия замет: The text stays in the notepad, and a copy of the notes is in the "Несохраненные заметки" folder next to the app settings (%APPDATA%\QG Knotes).
Освободите место или закройте программу,: Free up space or close the program that holds the file: the next edit or closing the notepad saves the notes.
